symbols.name: ICacheReadHandle
symbols.summary: Owns an independently positioned, lifetime-bounded snapshot stream and its provider reservations.
symbols.remarks: Dispose the handle asynchronously to release the snapshot and its resource reservations. Consume one handle sequentially, without concurrent reads or seeks. An acquired snapshot remains independent of later replacement or invalidation, but its configured transfer deadlines still apply. Payload integrity, destination writes, and transport delivery are separate outcomes. Successful acquisition alone does not establish payload integrity.

symbols.name: WaitForCompletionAsync(CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Observes completion without reading, draining, rewinding, or owning the destination.
symbols.remarks: Consume or dispose the stream before waiting for a terminal outcome, or observe it concurrently with consumption. Cancelling this observation does not cancel consumption or dispose the handle. Successful validation makes no claim about a destination or transport.

returns.description: Validated full consumption, completed range consumption, incomplete consumption, or a classified terminal failure.
Validated full consumption, completed range consumption, incomplete consumption, or a classified terminal failure.

symbols.name: Stream
symbols.summary: Gets logical bytes, with cache-managed envelopes/compression removed by the engine.
symbols.remarks: Read failures can throw BridgingIT.DevKit.Application.Caching.CacheTransferException. Dispose the handle even when consumption fails or stops early.

returns.description: The handle-owned stream. Its seekability and range are limited to the capabilities explicitly acquired.
The handle-owned stream. Its seekability and range are limited to the capabilities explicitly acquired.

symbols.name: Metadata
symbols.summary: Gets metadata for the same acquired immutable version.

returns.description: The identity, version, and bounded entry facts associated with this stream's snapshot.
The identity, version, and bounded entry facts associated with this stream's snapshot.

symbols.name: Range
symbols.summary: Gets the explicitly requested logical range, or null for a full/explicitly seekable handle.

returns.description: The acquired logical offset and byte count. Range completion does not assert whole-entry integrity.
The acquired logical offset and byte count. Range completion does not assert whole-entry integrity.

symbols.name: IntegrityScope
symbols.summary: Gets the integrity scope established by a successful terminal completion. Pending/incomplete/failed consumption establishes no such claim.

returns.description: The complete entry or the affected stored frames, as determined by the acquired access mode.
The complete entry or the affected stored frames, as determined by the acquired access mode.
